title: Smile and Winter
author: Ines Ravensworth
blurb: Orsen Fairweather, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
